# Instant Photo Sheet Maker

> Free, open-source web app that lays out photos as real-size instant-film prints (Instax Mini, Instax Square, Instax Wide, Polaroid Go, Polaroid i-Type/600) on a 4×6 in (152.4 × 101.6 mm) postcard sheet, exports at 300 DPI (1800 × 1200 px), and prints cut marks so the prints can be trimmed out. Designed for the Canon SELPHY CP1500 but works with any 4×6 photo printer. Runs entirely in the browser; photos are never uploaded.

## Key facts

- URL: https://photosheet.seanyasno.com/
- Price: free, no account, no uploads (all processing is client-side with the Canvas API)
- Input: JPEG, PNG, HEIC (EXIF orientation respected)
- Output: JPEG (quality 0.95) or PNG at 300 DPI, one file per sheet, or a ZIP of all sheets
- Sheet: 4×6 in, landscape or portrait, configurable gap (default 2 mm) and safe margin (default 2 mm)
- Borders: white or black, with the thick "chin" border at the bottom like real instant film
- Crop editor: pan, zoom and rotate each photo, locked to the film's aspect ratio
- Cutting: printed cut marks plus a numbered guillotine cut plan with distances from the sheet edge

## Print sizes (card / photo window, mm) and prints per 4×6 sheet

- Instax Mini: 54 × 86 / 46 × 62, 2 per sheet
- Instax Square: 72 × 86 / 62 × 62, 2 per sheet
- Instax Wide (horizontal): 108 × 86 / 99 × 62, 1 per sheet
- Instax Wide (vertical): 86 × 108 / 62 × 99, 1 per sheet
- Polaroid Go: 53.9 × 66.6 / 47 × 46, 2 per sheet
- Polaroid (i-Type / 600): 88 × 107 / 79 × 79, 1 per sheet

## How to use

1. Open https://photosheet.seanyasno.com/ and drop in photos.
2. Choose a film format; photos fill the sheets in order, and extra sheets are added automatically.
3. Click a print to adjust its crop.
4. Download the sheets and print at 100% (actual size) on 4×6 paper.
5. Cut along the marks: vertical cuts first, then horizontal.

Note: Canon SELPHY borderless printing enlarges the image slightly to bleed off the edge; the safe margin keeps content away from the trimmed edges.

## Links

- App: https://photosheet.seanyasno.com/
- Source code: https://github.com/seanyasno/instant-photo-sheet-maker
